shortDescription: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
description: Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, with insights by resource, environment, user, and feature.

shortDescription: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a workflow step
description: The Code node lets makers run Python as a workflow step for transformations, calculations, regex, advanced parsing, and file conversion.

shortDescription: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node
description: The Agent node can return generated PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV files as workflow outputs for downstream actions.

shortDescription: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners
description: Makers can share workflows with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage the workflow.

shortDescription: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
description: Workflows can be owned by a Microsoft Entra application service principal instead of a named user account.

shortDescription: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps
description: Add an agent node to reason over data, call tools, and return a response inside a workflow.

shortDescription: Federated Copilot connectors use Model Context Protocol
description: Federated Copilot connectors retrieve third-party data in real time through MCP while administrators retain governance and control.

shortDescription: SharePoint: Create and render HTML pages with Copilot
description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload HTML and render it from the pages library.
Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into agentic workflows through MCP support.

shortDescription: Copilot Studio agents can browse and interact with websites
description: Agents can navigate web pages, extract information, download files, and combine the results with other tools.

shortDescription: Copilot Studio cost management in Microsoft 365 admin center
description: Administrators get centralized Copilot Credit cost management and spending-policy support for Copilot Studio environments and agents.

shortDescription: Microsoft Purview DLP expands to Microsoft Cowork
description: Purview DLP policies extend to Microsoft Cowork to protect sensitive AI interactions and restrict unsupported data sharing.
